title: Enable Beatmap Video
description: Play video background if available (.mp4). Falls back to cover image if not.

title: Video Only in Song Selection Menu
description: Play video only during song selection and menu preview, and switch to static cover image during gameplay.

title: Background Dim [%]
description: Dim the background brightness (0 = original brightness, 100 = completely dark, recommended: 60-80).

title: Game Width [px]
description: Width of your in-game resolution (default 1440). Set to 0 to disable cutout.

title: Game Height [px]
description: Height of your in-game resolution (default 900). Set to 0 to disable cutout.

title: Game Offset X [px]
description: Horizontal offset from screen center in pixels (0 = center).

title: Game Offset Y [px]
description: Vertical offset from screen center in pixels (0 = center).

title: Border Shadow / Glow [px]
description: Shadow blur around the game border in px (0 for sharp cut, e.g. 15 for soft shadow).
